desc: four players at a new file's very start (Rogueport's harbour, the arrival scene, no partner yet): every player has someone: player 2 a lent Goombella, player 3 a lent Koops, player 4 a lent Flurrie. Player 2's X does nothing (no ability); player 2's L gives the next lent one (Yoshi: Koops and Flurrie are taken). Then Goombella joins and comes out: player 2's lent partner goes and player 2 plays Goombella; players 3 and 4 keep a lent partner each. Shots: all_lent ('2P' over Goombella, '3P' Koops, '4P' Flurrie, Mario's partner slot empty), p2_next (Yoshi with '2P'), joined (Goombella the real partner with '2P', Koops and Flurrie still there), pause_party (the pause menu: no lent partner anywhere)
